description: This script contains functions related to managing UBI partitions, mounting boot partitions, copying configurations, performing upgrades, and moving configurations for an i.MX device in an OpenWrt environment.

methods.name: rootpartuuid
methods.description: Extracts the UUID of the root partition from the kernel command line.

methods.name: bootdev_from_uuid
methods.description: Finds the device name corresponding to the partition UUID.

methods.name: bootpart_from_uuid
methods.description: Gets the device name for the boot partition associated with the UUID.

methods.name: rootpart_from_uuid
methods.description: Gets the device name for the root partition associated with the UUID.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_mount_boot
methods.description: Mounts the boot partition at /boot, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the /boot partition.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a system upgrade by extracting kernel and root filesystem from an image tarball.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Pre-upgrade preparation, resetting JFFS2 and unmounting overlay if no backup is set.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_move_config
methods.description: Moves the backup configuration file from the boot partition to root if the partition is a block device.
